basis: Inherited platelet deficiency and dysfunction; mucocutaneous bleeding does not establish damage to additional organs.
Tuberculous infection of lymph nodes; pulmonary involvement is not inherent to this localized diagnosis.
Neoplasm arising in cranial nerves; no additional organ damage applies across most subtypes.
Malignant mixed germ cell tumor arising within the central nervous system.
Congenital or hereditary pituitary hormone deficiency; additional structural organ damage is not shared across the group.
Hereditary susceptibility specifically to a blood-cell malignancy; this label identifies the disease domain, not established leukemia or secondary organ damage.
Chondroid hamartoma most commonly denotes a pulmonary hamartoma, but the supplied definition specifies cartilage elements without an anatomical site.
Functional disorder of the urinary bladder with abnormal detrusor activity.
Stones originate within intrahepatic bile ducts, causing biliary obstruction and recurrent local inflammation.
Lysosomal storage disorder; skeletal dysplasia in 4/4 and aortic valve disease in 2/4. Floaters and tooth spacing alone do not establish additional organ damage.
Inherited magnesium imbalance; cramps, tetany and tremor reflect electrolyte dysfunction without established intrinsic muscle or nerve damage.
Inherited neurometabolic dystonia; hearing impairment is annotated at 30-79%. Dystonic postures do not establish independent skeletal damage.
Defining skeletal dysplasia; lung hypoplasia and cognitive impairment occur in 80-99%, hearing impairment in 30-79%. Redundant skin alone is not damage.
Sensory/autonomic neuropathy and auditory dysfunction define the syndrome; hearing loss in 16/16. Myopia in 4/16 is below 30%.
Cobalamin metabolic disorder; severe encephalopathy, developmental disability and seizures in 1/1. Hypermetropia/esotropia alone do not establish direct ocular injury.
Hypomyelinating leukodystrophy; hypogonadism, missing teeth and myopia each 30-79%. Optic atrophy <30%; neurogenic bladder does not establish intrinsic urinary damage.
Chronic pericardial inflammation due to the immune-mediated rheumatic disease process.
Fourth branchial tract anomalies characteristically connect to the hypopharyngeal pyriform sinus. Secondary thyroid infection does not establish endocrine dysfunction.
Central disorder of sleep-wake regulation; sleep-related hallucinations do not make this a purely psychiatric condition.
Inherited platelet dysfunction with characteristic early-onset gastrointestinal ulceration; both are defining manifestations.
Adenocarcinoma arising from duodenal glandular epithelium.
Autoimmune inflammation of mesial temporal brain structures; psychiatric manifestations arise from encephalitis.
Inherited erythrocyte metabolic enzyme deficiency causing abnormal red-cell physiology, including erythrocytosis or hemolysis; spleen remains within the blood axis.
Hypothyroidism with defining cardiac dysfunction and refractory heart failure; cardiac involvement is intrinsic to this specific diagnosis.
ICOS-related antibody immunodeficiency; recurrent infections are separately diagnosed. Bronchiectasis frequency is unspecified; autoimmune neutropenia occurs in only 5-29%.
